hits.snippet: # Found Industries Opens Cambridge Headquarters and Critical-Metals Process Development Center Found Industries, an MIT spinout developing technologies aimed at strengthening domestic critical-materials and energy production, has opened a new headquarters and Found Metals Process Development Center in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The facility is designed to help Found move technologies from laboratory research into continuously operating industrial processes using real-world feedstocks. Scientists, engineers and technicians at the center will develop and test systems for recovering critical metals from existing industrial streams and producing qualified materials for U.S. customers. [...] While Cambridge will serve as Found Industries’ corporate headquarters and principal metals process-development center, the company will maintain operations in Boston supporting its energy projects. The shell for Egret Point was completed earlier this year – ahead of schedule and under budget.
